part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `handleHTTPRequest` at gin.go:759 — the NoRoute fallback called `serveError(c, http.StatusOK, ...)` instead of `http.StatusNotFound`, so unmatched routes returned 200 with the 404 body text.

- Changed to `serveError(c, http.StatusNotFound, default404Body)`.
- All routing tests pass: `go test -run 'TestRoute|TestNoRoute|TestNotFound|TestMethodNotAllowed|TestEngine' .` → ok.
- Full suite has 4 pre-existing failures (`TestSaveUploadedFile*`, `TestFileDescriptor`) — verified they fail on the unmutated tree too; Windows chmod-semantics issues unrelated to routing.
